summary: BI-52280538 (EP-5F6369AB). The EA metamodel's generic associations become typed relationships: ArchiMate realizes / serves / aggregates / influences / assigned_to where ArchiMate defines one, and three W3C PROV-O extension types (evidenced_by, generates, attributed_to) for governance evidence. BPMN association becomes annotates / compensates_with / data_association. Cross-layer SysML traces carry a traceKind. Migration 20261028090000_register_ea_provenance_relations registers the five new graph relation types.
affectedCopies: EaRelationshipType, EaRelationshipRule, EaDqRule, EaTraversalPattern, ViewpointDefinition (archimate4, bpmn20): rewritten by the seeds on every container start; association rules no longer declared are deleted by pruneRetiredAssociationRules
EaRelationship rows written by sysml-model-seed cross-layer projections: properties.traceKind added on their next reconcile

privacyAssessment.reviewDisposition: Reference data shipped with the platform.
